observable_scene: At 3 and 4 seconds, an upright pedestrian is visible on the road surface between a car and motorcycles; additional vehicles occupy the road behind them.
The scene does not show a person down, an injury, or a collision.

Near 1 second the pedestrian is occluded by a car. Near 5 seconds a foreground three-wheeled vehicle crosses the view and partly occludes the pedestrian. Near 8 seconds foreground traffic again blocks part of the view.
